message.content: {"overview":{"summary":"The MCHA Farmdale Apartments project at 1219 & 1233 W Lincoln Street involves modification of conditions originally approved by the Planning Commission on June 26, 2025. The applicant requested removal of a required mid-block bicycle/pedestrian corridor and restricting cross-access vehicular easement between two newly created parcels to emergency and maintenance vehicles only. Staff recommended partial approval: denying removal of the bicycle/pedestrian corridor but relocating it to Parcel 2, and approving the restricted access easement modification. The Planning Commission held a public hearing, with no public opposition, and voted unanimously to approve partial modification per staff recommendations. The final decision leaves all other conditions intact from the original approval.","evidence":[{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p1:s1"},{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p1:s2"},{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p2:s1"},{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p4:s1"}]},"timeline":[{"date":"2025-10-14","kind":"submission","title":"Application submitted","detail":"The Modification of Conditions (MOC) application package was submitted on October 14, 2025, including requests to remove the mid-block bicycle/pedestrian corridor and restrict parcel cross-access.","evidence":[{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p12:s2"},{"passageId":"completeness-letter-2025-10-29:p1:s2"},{"passageId":"staff-report-2025-12-04:p13:s5"}]},{"date":"2025-10-29","kind":"completeness","title":"Application deemed complete","detail":"Staff reviewed the MOC application and deemed it complete on October 29, 2025. Two modification requests were identified: removal of mid-block bicycle/pedestrian corridor, and restriction of private access easement to emergency and maintenance vehicles only. Staff notified applicant of hearing date and sign posting requirements.","evidence":[{"passageId":"completeness-letter-2025-10-29:p1:s1"},{"passageId":"completeness-letter-2025-10-29:p1:s2"},{"passageId":"completeness-letter-2025-10-29:p1:s3"}]},{"date":"2025-12-04","kind":"recommendation","title":"Staff recommendation published","detail":"Staff recommended partial approval of the modification requests.
